name: selvage
description: Live collaborative editing over the Selvage session protocol

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Every command works in a window you have not trusted. What waits for trust is the resume a `.selvage-mirror.json` marker asks for at activation, because a file named like the marker in a folder is enough to start this extension there. A window opened on the extension's own room folder, under its storage, resumes without trust, so a guest can keep the room in Restricted Mode.

Open a document from the room
Download a file from the room

viewsWelcome.contents:
Share a folder with a friend and edit the same files. They join from a browser.
[Host a session](command:selvage.host)
[Join a session from an invite link](command:selvage.join)

selvage.serverUrl.description: The server address to host on: in full, or a domain on its own (a domain alone means the secure server). Set it and hosting never asks. A ws:// address given to the command outranks it, and it outranks the last server used. The Selvage: Change the server command reports which address is in force.

selvage.displayName.description: The name other participants see. At most 32 UTF-16 code units, so an emoji costs two; a longer name is refused. A change while a session is live renames this connection at once, and applies to the next host or join.

selvage.autoSave.description: Save a document the room changed, once the room has settled on it. With this off, a remote edit leaves the file on disk stale, with the editor's unsaved marker still on it.

selvage.openOnJoin.description: Put the room's first document in an editor when a guest joins, and when a room that was empty at join reports its first document. Only the first; the Selvage: Open a document from the room command lists every path. A host is unaffected.

enumDescriptions: Draw no name over the document. A peer is shown by their coloured caret and selection, a tick in the overview ruler, and the name in the caret's hover.
A small name box above the caret, out of the line's flow. It covers the line above the caret and leans on undocumented editor behaviour.
The peer's name inside the line, behind a coloured border, from documented decoration fields only. It covers the text it sits against.
selvage.cursorLabel.description: Whether a remote peer's name is drawn at their cursor. "floating" and "chip" each cover some of the text; the full name is always in the caret's hover and in the status bar.
